posts.name: Sonvar
posts.cooked: Probably my current iPad

posts.name: Matchstickman
posts.cooked:
Looks like I asked a question I can't answer, I am very greatful for the presents I received at teh time I received them but honestly now I can't remember a single one that stands out above the others.

 

New day, new question!

What was your last take out/delivery food? Was it good?

posts.name: Sonvar
posts.cooked: Pizza and it was just ok.   Didn’t help that the order got split up because the delivery guy didn’t have the whole order.

posts.name: Matchstickman
posts.cooked:
My last take out was (open) chips. Walking home late out in the cold and dark eating chips slathered in salt and vineger, it was great. And it brings back childhood memories of doing the same when visting my grand parents.

 

New day, new question!

Nostalgia! Do you harken back to the good olde days? Are you happy things from your childhood are getting a revival? Are they (or are you too young, you whippersnapper!)?

 

 

Question of the (holi)day will be disrupted while the festive period interferes with my posting schedule, if I don't get a question up feel free to post one yourself, or continue answering the same question until I post a new one.

posts.name: Rabit
posts.cooked:
I'm definitely old enough. ;-)

I'm shocked but happy the things I've enjoyed most of my life like superheroes and RPGs like D&D have become socially acceptable.

But I think the way Hollywood is "reinventing" some of the old media is kind of sad. :-/ (Having said that, I'm looking forward to getting our first Transformer movie with Bumblebee! :-D )

posts.name: Ameena
posts.cooked:
Yeah, I wish they'd stop "rebooting" old films and just come up with some new ideas and make those instead :P.

Games-wise I'm wondering how long it'll be before the big-name companies go under due to trying to screw over their customers so much they end up without any customers, meanwhile all the little indy companies with a single-figure total of people will take over again and sell all the actually decent games at reasonable prices :D. At least I have emulators now to replay all the old games I used to play but that wouldn't normally run on my current PC due to being from the Atari or needing DOS/a floppy drive. So if I feel like playing anything from back in the '80s/'90s I can just load it up whenever I like and get on with it :D.

posts.name: Matchstickman
posts.cooked:
Yeah, I'm old enough to see my childhood revived.

I'm not a big fan of movie or TV reboots for some reason (possibly because they're passive and I have no say it what happens) but computer games and the like get my thumbs up.

 

New year, new question!

Did you miss me?

Bonus question!

It's only the fifth day of the new year, how many resolutions have you broken so far? Do you make resolutions?

posts.name: Sonvar
posts.cooked: No, as you show up other places :P.  I did not make any resolutions and typically don’t.

posts.name: Ameena
posts.cooked:
Well, I wasn't aiming for you, so...no?

And I've never bothered with New Year's Resolutions. Bleh :P.

posts.name: Matchstickman
posts.cooked:
I, like the rest of you, did not miss me either.

Oh, and I don't make resolutions either.

 

New day, new question!

Photos! Do you take photos in your everyday life? Do you instagram your meals?

posts.name: Sonvar
posts.cooked: I take some photos but not everyday.  I do not use Instagram nor do I take pics of my food

posts.name: Rabit
posts.cooked: I take pics on occasion, but -- as Powerhound -- not daily. I don't post pictures very often to social media (and never to Instagram), and usually it's a images from a specific event, such as a trip/holiday, a convention, or a gathering of friends / folks who might be specifically interested in such images.

posts.name: Ameena
posts.cooked: I don't have a camera, so no. I take screnshots occasionally in games with cool imagery that I want to use as desktop wallpapers, though, if that counts ;).

posts.name: Phantom5613
posts.cooked: I'll normally only take pictures of something if I have an interest in it, like the cover of a book I found in a store or maybe of an interesting landscape, or maybe a funny thing a relative is doing. I don't post photos to any social media as a general rule, but once in a while I'll show the picture to friends.

posts.name: Matchstickman
posts.cooked:
I'm not a visual person, so I don't take photos, not even on when I go on vacation.

 

New day, new question!

Anything you are looking forward to this year? Exciting holiday plans, release of a new film/book/game, new job?

posts.name: Phantom5613
posts.cooked: I'm looking forward to the continuation of the Avengers movies, the payout for several Kickstarters I backed, and the new Pokemon and Animal Crossing games that will hopefully be released this year. I also have a trip coming up, so there's that to look forward to as well.

posts.name: dprcooke
posts.cooked: I'm looking forward to a 4-day boardgaming weekend coming up in just 2 weeks(!), camping this summer with my s/o, visiting some friends who live in Edmonton, and a friend's wedding this Fall.  (Plus a bunch of other stuff too!)

posts.name: BrianleWolfhunt
posts.cooked: Sentinels: OblivAeon digital, Obviously.

posts.name: Dandolo
posts.cooked:
Lots to look forward to this year. I'm going to visit some of my friends from college who I haven't seen in a few years, so really looking forward to that. Also, I'm planning a trip to Scotland, which I'm looking forward to as well.

In terms of movies there's a lot coming out this year in terms of superhero stuff. Also excited to get new movies from Quinton Terentino, J.C. Chandor, and David Robert Mitchell.

In terms of games I'm mostly just excited for everything Handelabra is working on.

posts.name: Matchstickman
posts.cooked:
I very much take things as I find them so there's little I ever really look forward to... in fact the only thing I can think of that I am actively looking forward to is the Cyberpunk 2077 game coming out, and there's no guarantee that's coming out this year!

EDIT: I thought of something! The last issue of Mage- The Hero Denied is out in February, a story 30 odd years in the making, I am defintely looking forward to that (with some trepidation)!

 

New day, new question!

Mouse mats! Do you have one? What’s the picture of?

posts.name: Hankroyd
posts.cooked: Wait, mouse mat is still a thing? That is so 1995... :)

posts.name: dprcooke
posts.cooked:
I do.  It's got the cover art for Max Payne on it.

I think I got it either with Max Payne or purchased it separately around the same time... but it's been a long time since then so it's hard to remember.

posts.name: PlatinumWarlock
posts.cooked:
I use one at work; it's emblazoned with the university logo. 

I also have a Pittsburgh Steelers one at home in our office, but we rarely use our office outside of the occasional guest stay on the futon and my wife's yarn storage.

posts.name: Rabit
posts.cooked:
I have two, as I use both of my hands (to help reduce wrist strain): 

  • Left: This beautiful piece from Nolan Nasser (who did a bunch of Spirit Island art)
  • Right: A work of art featuring Serenity and the words "Can't take the sky from me", from the artist known as "11th Hour" (Susan Tomb, who sadly passed away back in 2011)

link_counts.title: Rest In Peace 11th Hour - Firefly&Serenity - Whedonesque.com

posts.name: Matchstickman
posts.cooked:
I have a trackerball mouse, but I still rest it on a mousepad! It's one I got at the Doctor Who experience sometime back, the TARDIS making it's way through the vortex.

 

New day, new question!

Continuing on with the "things with pictures on them" theme, Umbrellas! Do you have one? Does it have pictures on it?

posts.name: Sonvar
posts.cooked: I have some but not with any pictures.

posts.name: Rabit
posts.cooked: I have a couple, but the only one that's interesting is the rainbow umbrella that I specifically bought to use at Pride parades to shade myself from the sun. :-)

posts.name: dprcooke
posts.cooked: Every 3-5 years I decide I need an umbrella, buy one, and then promptly go about losing it within 2 weeks of purchase.  So no umbrella for me.

posts.name: BrianleWolfhunt
posts.cooked: I dance in the rain. I don't need an umbrella. :)

posts.name: Rabit
posts.cooked:
BrianleWolfhunt:

I dance in the rain. I don’t need an umbrella.

Oh, definitely! (I’m originally from the Pacific Northwest.

It’s the sun I need to protect myself against… :-\

posts.name: BrianleWolfhunt
posts.cooked:
Rabit:

It’s the sun I need to protect myself against… :-\

I hear you. I got a sunburn last summer that hurt for weeks afterwards.

posts.name: Matchstickman
posts.cooked:
I have an umbrella, but I never use it, even if it's absolutely tipping down. It's just a plain black one. I just find them more trouble at the end of the journey than benefit during it.

 

New day, new quesiton!

A day in the life! Is there any one specific person you would want to be for a day? Someone famous, someone with a particular job you've always been interested in, a person who was somewhere when a particular thing happened?

posts.name: Phantom5613
posts.cooked:
When I went to Epcot I got an umbrella as a souvenier from the Japanese pavilion. The handle looks like a sword's hilt, and it comes in this cool sling that you can wear across your back(Yes, I'm a weeb). What's REALLY cool is that when water falls on the normally black material, you can see all these different symbols for different houses of samurai.

But as luck would have it, something bad happened when my friend shipped it to me. One end of the cardbord box was smashed and looked like an accordian leaning to one side, and my poor umbrella's handle was bent. :( Thankfully my dad is a bit of a fix-it man, and was able to get it back to a usable state.

Sundau Question: Has a package ever been shipped to you in a damaged state? What'd it look like? Were your items damaged, or were the shipping gods kind and your stuff was unharmed?

posts.name: Matchstickman
posts.cooked:
No one interested in admitting to wanting to be another person? I can't think of anyone either.

 

Sunday question- I think I've had a bent card in a game that was shipped to me once, but that's about it.

 

New day, new question!

Speaking of things arriving in the mail...

Single use Monocles! What’s the biggest single "wasteful" purchase you have made?

posts.name: Phantom5613
posts.cooked:
So I guess it's just me that gets packages smashed every so often. :/

How can a Monocle be made 'single-use'?

I suppose my most wasteful purchase could be any of the numerous games that I've bought but still haven't gotten the chance to play...

posts.name: Rabit
posts.cooked:
Nah, I've had a few packages destroyed, just didn't have a chance to get out here in time to answer. :-\ Usually what was being delivered is okay -- or good enough I'm not going to stress over it -- but I've had a couple items that were destroyed. 

My wasteful purchases are usually things I already had and forgot / didn't know we had.

Something I've also had happen is when Amazon sends me a notice that the  vendor I bought something from said it had been damaged during shipping (overlapping the two questions! :-) so they cancelled my order, and I'd have to re-order it. Which I do. And then the original order arrives. Followed by the second order... :-\ I just had this happen for the third time over the weekend, but this time I waited and didn't order again, so I won't get a second one. :-)

posts.name: Matchstickman
posts.cooked:
Phantom5613:

How can a Monocle be made ‘single-use’?

I have no idea but Zach Weinersmith somehow managed it.

Wasteful purchases? I there was a board/miniatures game I was interested in where the company that made it was going out of business, I bought some £200 worth of stuff for it and I haven’t touched it since I got it.

 

New day, new question!

Speaking of Monocles, Glasses! Do you wear them? Do you wear contact lenses? Have you has laser eye surgery to correct your eyesight?

posts.name: Phantom5613
posts.cooked: I wear glasses, and I don't plan on getting surgery any time soon.

posts.name: Sonvar
posts.cooked: Glasses.   I wore contacts for a while but my eyes felt so dried out. I have no had laser eye surgery nor do I plan too.

posts.name: Matchstickman
posts.cooked:
I also wear glasses, occassionally. Never wanted to try contacts, I don't think I could put my finger in my eye every day.

 

New day, new question!

Speaking of bad senses, if you had to lose all but one of your senses, which would you save? Why that one?

posts.name: Ameena
posts.cooked: Probably eyesight - don't think I'd want to be unable to read. I suppose maybe smell would be second, so I could at least mostly enjoy food (I think about 80% of the flavour of food comes via smell, not taste). Then again, not being able to experience touch would make a lot of things very difficult (holding things, using a mouse and keyboard, etc). Hmm...I think what I'm saying is that the one I would least be worried ot lose would be hearing. But I'd still rather not lose that ;).

posts.name: BrianleWolfhunt
posts.cooked: I'd be fine if I lost touch, taste, or smell. Hearing and sight are important to me though. Sight above all I guess.

posts.name: Matchstickman
posts.cooked:
Of all my senses, I think my sense of self is the one I would miss the most.

 

New day, new question!

High Five! Are you expressive with your hands? Do you give people a thumbs up? What's your favourite/most used hand gesture?

posts.name: UXM266
posts.cooked:
I talk with my hands a lot. Super expressive. 

I gesture to emphasize, and for fun. 

One of my most used or favourite USB to add the “snap” to various actions. The snap and point for “you got this/hey there “.

posts.name: Sonvar
posts.cooked: I typically flail my hands around when speaking to audiences as I get nervous but in smaller setting I am not very expressive with my hands.

posts.name: Ameena
posts.cooked: I tend to wave my hands around/gesture a lot whilst talking. I often wave hello/goodbye to people as well, and clap when excited/something cool happens. But it's not usually very open and expansive, more kind of closer in to myself.

posts.name: BrianleWolfhunt
posts.cooked: I tend to use my hands as an alternative to speaking with words, either out of laziness or comedic effect. My favorite gesture is the facepalm.

posts.name: Matchstickman
posts.cooked:
I'm not very expressive with my hands, usually. I've played a few RPGs where my characters were so I did it then, wiggling my fingers around as a wave and acting out my groups exploits via flinging my arms around, usually resulting in knocking over someone's drink (in game only). Outisde of that, the High Five is my most common hand gesture.

 

New day, new question!

For he's a jolly good fellow! Do you have a favourite celebratory song?

posts.name: Sonvar
posts.cooked: We Are The Champions by Queen is what first comes to mind.

posts.name: Matchstickman
posts.cooked:
Good pick! That's what I would go with too.

 

New day, new question!

MP3s, vinyl, tapes, CDs, what medium did you grow up listening to? Can you tell any difference in sound quality as technology has progressed (or regressed if you prefer)?
